Value and readout:** digit value = digit × 2π/10/1e-5. The digit logits are cos(z − 2π/10·(d + 0.5 − 5e-6)), and the non-digit tokens are masked. Everything runs in float64.

I haven't checked the description's float32 claim (accuracy dropping to about 0.5%). The script to test it was blocked pending your approval, so I skipped it. The model fits the description as written, and I didn't make it more robust than the original.

Final model: `interpretable_transformers_lib/RingAngleCrossAttn27.py`.
